title: A cleaner Today, personal bests as they happen, notes and tips, and better updates
notes: Today greets you by name, shows calories left as a ring, and carries a short note and a tip for the day. Settings, Look switches the notes off.
Workout: a progress line for the session, the next exercise marked, finished exercises folded to one line, and a PR flag the moment a set beats your best.
The rest timer drains a bar as the rest runs out and shows a tip, or the personal best you just set.
Food shows the ring too, with how much protein is still to go and a tip that reacts to the day.
Progress opens with a summary row: sessions, kilograms lifted and average effort.
Updates: the banner lists what is new, Android shows the download as it happens, and the first open after an update tells you what changed.

title: Pick your own colour, and a simpler, quieter app
notes: Settings, Look: light, dark or the same as the device, and a colour of your own from seven swatches or a picker.
A fixed bottom bar with Today, Workout, Food, Plan and More, where More opens Progress, History and Settings.
Settings folded into short sections; Today's stats in one row; shorter labels on the week strip.

title: More than one session a day, and the steppers redrawn
notes: A day can hold more than one session, and Settings has a sessions-a-day choice.
The weight stepper is drawn as a dumbbell and the reps stepper as a tally that fills towards the target.

title: Automatic update check, HIIT and Cardio-first splits
notes: The app checks GitHub for a new version by itself and shows a banner with an Update button.
Two new training splits: HIIT, with interval sessions and a circuit, and Cardio first, with intervals, tempo and a long steady session.

title: Every exercise asks for what it needs
notes: Hold timers for planks and carries, cardio cards with timers for the machines, and plates a side on every barbell lift.

title: Plates per side, a rest timer that survives leaving the app, USDA search and drinks
notes: Barbell weights can be typed as the total or as plates each side.
The rest timer carries on where it was when you come back to the app.
Online search asks USDA FoodData Central for dishes and drinks, and a drinks list is bundled.

title: How-to notes and videos, warm-up and cool-down routines, iPhone web app
notes: Every exercise has a short description, form cues and a verified video.
Warm-up and cool-down routines on every session.
The web app installs on an iPhone from Safari's Share menu.

title: First release
notes: Workouts, a rotating four-week plan, food with calories and macros, progress charts and backups, all stored on the phone.
